message.content: In one of the conversations, Li Hua expressed her preference for a medium rare patty, stating "I just love the juicy texture of a medium rare patty. That's where all the flavor is for me!" However, Wolfgang Schulz held a different opinion, favoring a well-done patty for safety and flavor. He said, "I think well-done is just safer and more flavorful." Therefore, based on these statements, it appears that while Li Hua prefers a medium rare patty, Wolfgang Schulz leans towards a well-done patty.
